court_name: Superior Court of California, County of San Benito
case_search_note: Public Portal — case/calendar lookup (cases, traffic citations, daily calendar). Remote access has exceptions for some case types (CRC 2.500). Document images only for named parties/attorneys after an ID-verified access request. Questions: PortalAdmin@sanbenitocourt.org.

courthouses.name: San Benito County Superior Court — Main Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Building Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; Criminal Division phone 8:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.
courthouses.note: Only courthouse; hears all case types including criminal, traffic, juvenile delinquency and mental health. Felony & misdemeanor walk-in court Mon–Fri: check in 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m., court starts 1:30 p.m. Check the wall calendar for your courtroom.

legal_aid.name: San Benito Superior Court Self-Help Center
legal_aid.what: Brief (under 15 min) free guidance and forms for small claims, guardianship, name change, DV/restraining orders, family law, evictions (limited) and more; no representation, no interpreters on site.
legal_aid.phone: (831) 636-4057 (leave a message; calls returned within a week)

programs.name: Felony & Misdemeanor Walk-In Court
programs.summary: Mon–Fri check in at the clerk window 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. with your case number and reason; court starts at 1:30 p.m.

jails.name: San Benito County Jail (incl. Curtis J. Hill Rehabilitation Center)
jails.phone_note: Visits must be arranged by phone: (831) 636-4060 or (831) 902-8945 (schedules not posted online); Rehabilitation Center procedures may differ. Account deposits: Access Corrections (accesscorrections.com, 866-345-1884) or lobby kiosk, or mail. Bail may be posted at the jail by cashier's check, certified check, money order or bail bond.
jails.court_ids_note: County's only courthouse; transport not described by the Sheriff.

bail.note: Before paying a bail agent, check that their license is active using the California Department of Insurance license lookup (search by name or license number). San Benito Superior Court posts its 2025 Felony and Misdemeanor Bail Schedule at https://www.sanbenito.courts.ca.gov/system/files/general/2025-felony-and-misdemeanor-bail-schedule.pdf. Cash-type bail at the jail must be cashier's check, certified check or money order. No county online inmate locator was found; the Sheriff links the California VINE system for custody status. This is information only, not legal advice.
